message.content:
Buddhism was founded by **Siddhārtha Gautama**, who is commonly known as the **Buddha** (“the awakened one”). He lived in the 5th–4th centuries BCE.

The religion **originated in ancient India**, specifically in the region that is now part of **southern Nepal and northern India**. The traditional birthplace of the Buddha is **Lumbini** (in present‑day Nepal), and his early life and teachings unfolded in the surrounding areas of the Indian subcontinent.

The user asked: "Who was the founder of Buddhism and where was it originated?" So we should provide that. We can also mention that Buddhism originated in ancient India, in the region of present-day Nepal/India. Provide details. No function calls needed.
